title: mxv/status/v1
description: Each process of the workspace's manifest in start order, then each other process that has run files, with its state, and the manifest's error when it does not parse.

dry_run.description: Present, and true, when the run was a dry run that changed nothing.

data.description: The rows of the page, up to the limit.

total.description: The number of rows that matched, of which data holds one page. It is absent when the tool did not count the rows.

truncated.description: True when the document leaves out rows that matched, because of the limit or the output budget, and false when data holds every row.

cut.description: Present when the output budget cut the result short, so data holds only its first rows.

code.description: The over-budget code, in the tool's spelling.

budget.description: The most bytes that the run printed on standard output.

ProcessRow.description:
One process or container of a workspace, as `up`, `down`, `restart`
and `status` print it.

name.description: The process's or container's name in the manifest.

state.description:
`running`, `exited` when it ended on its own or something other
than `mxv down` stopped it, `created` for a container that docker
created and did not start, `stopped`, `starting` while it is not
ready yet, `stopping`, `restarting` while docker restarts a
container, or `unknown` when mxv cannot tell.

pid.description:
The process id, which is also its process group's id, while a
process runs, and null for a container.

code.description:
The exit code of an exited process, or null when a signal ended it
or it has not exited. A container's code is the one docker reports,
such as 137 for a container that SIGKILL ended.

signal.description:
The number of the signal that ended an exited process, such as 15
for SIGTERM, or null.

reason.description:
Why mxv cannot tell the state of an `unknown` process, or why it
does not know the exit code of an exited process that an earlier
version of mxv started, such as one whose group SIGKILL ended
before its shell wrote the exit file, or null when it knows.

group_alive.description:
Whether the process group of an exited process that an earlier
version of mxv started still has a member, such as a child it
started in the background, which `mxv down` stops. It is null while
the process runs, and for every process that phase runs, because
phase stops what is left of a process's group when the process
ends.

ports.description:
The ports that a process receives, as `VARIABLE=port`, or that a
container publishes, as `port-name=port`.

log.description:
The process's log file, which `mxv logs` prints, or null for a
container, whose output docker keeps and `mxv logs` also prints.

KindName.description: Whether a row is a process or a container.

oneOf.description: A process that mxv starts on the host.
A container that mxv runs with docker.

StateName.description: The state of a process, as a row prints it.

oneOf.description: docker created the container and did not start it.
The process started and is not ready yet.
mxv cannot tell the process's state.

StatusSummary.description:
What `mxv status` says above its rows: which manifest the workspace
reads, whether it could be read, and its warnings.

manifest.description:
Which manifest the workspace's commands read: `workspace` for the
workspace manifest above the checkout, `repository` for the
checkout's own `mxv.toml`, `merged` for the files of a workspace
with several checkouts, or `none` for a bare workspace.

manifest_path.description:
The path of the manifest that the workspace's commands read, or
null when they read none. For a merged manifest, it is the
workspace manifest when it exists, or else the first checkout's
`mxv.toml`.

manifest_paths.description: Every file that the workspace's commands read.

manifest_error.description:
The manifest's error when it cannot be read or does not parse, in
which case the rows come from the run records alone, or null.

warnings.description:
One sentence for each table of the manifest that mxv ignores
although its name is close to one of mxv's own, such as
`[proceses.web]`.

checkouts.description:
Each checkout of the workspace, with the branch and commit it has
checked out and how many of its entries are uncommitted or
untracked.

ManifestRow.description: Which manifest a workspace's commands read.

oneOf.description: The workspace manifest, `<workspace>/mxv.toml`, above the checkout.

The workspace manifest and each checkout's own `mxv.toml`, merged,
in a workspace with several checkouts.
Neither file, so the workspace is bare.

CheckoutStateRow.description: One checkout of a workspace, as `mxv status` reports it.

name.description: The checkout's folder, which `mxv cd <NAME> <CHECKOUT>` takes.

branch.description:
The branch that the checkout has checked out, or null for a
detached `HEAD` or a checkout that git cannot read.

commit.description: The commit that the checkout's `HEAD` names, or null.

changes.description:
How many entries of the checkout are uncommitted changes or
untracked paths, as `git status --porcelain` counts them, or null
when git cannot read the checkout.

problem.description:
Why git cannot read the checkout, such as a directory that is
gone, or null.
